description: Golden vectors for Kodium.pqc.generateKeyPair(seed) and Kodium.generateKeyPair(seed). These vectors are the contract: a change to any of them is a breaking change.
hybridDerivation: prk = HKDF-Extract-SHA-256(salt = UTF-8("kodium-seeded-hybrid-v1"), ikm = seed); classicalSecret = HKDF-Expand(prk, "ed25519-seed", 32) used as both the X25519 secret key and the Ed25519 seed; mlkemD = HKDF-Expand(prk, "mlkem-d", 32); mlkemZ = HKDF-Expand(prk, "mlkem-z", 32); ML-KEM-768 = FIPS 203 ML-KEM.KeyGen_internal(mlkemD, mlkemZ)
ed25519Derivation: secretKey = HKDF-Expand(HKDF-Extract-SHA-256(salt = UTF-8("kodium-seeded-ed25519-v1"), ikm = seed), "ed25519-seed", 32) used as both the X25519 secret key and the Ed25519 seed
